title: Component Variables Manifest
description: Declares CSS custom properties for a KeenMate web component - both the --base-* variables it consumes and the component-specific variables it exposes.

prefix.description: CSS variable prefix without dashes (e.g., 'wg' for --wg-*)

baseVariables.description: List of --base-* variables this component consumes from the theme layer

componentVariables.description: List of component-specific CSS variables (--prefix-*) the component exposes

name.description: Base variable name without -- prefix (e.g., base-accent-color)

required.description: Whether this variable is required for the component to render correctly

usage.description: How this variable is used in the component

name.description: Component variable name without -- prefix (e.g., wg-header-bg)

category.description: Category for grouping in theme-designer UI (e.g., header, cell, toolbar)

usage.description: What this variable controls in the UI
